title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm out and about with Gold Ship…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Look at that clear box over there! There are tons of Umamusume trapped in it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship points toward a claw machine filled with Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Who would do such a thing?! Hang on, everyone! Help is on the way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship reassures the plushies behind the glass.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, you're not the type that would abandon all these poor Umamusume, are you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Good! Go in there and show us your stuff! I'm ready to witness the greatest rescue operation of the century!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
